moral: True courage is believing in yourself and helping others even when you are afraid.

story: Clara Mae Johnson is a brave young cowgirl from Dusty Hollow who dreams of becoming the Champion of the West. Encouraged by her best friend Billy, she decides to enter the Great Western Rodeo despite her fears and doubts. At the rodeo, she feels nervous when she sees experienced competitors, but with support from Billy and a friendly rider named Annie, she gathers confidence. Clara performs well in roping and barrel racing, impressing the crowd and gaining belief in her abilities. When a wild horse named Black Shadow panics, Clara calms it with patience and kindness, earning admiration from everyone. Later, she bravely takes on bull riding, facing her fears head-on. Although she does not win the championship, Clara learns that true courage comes from trying your best and helping others. Inspired by her journey, she returns to Dusty Hollow and organizes a community rodeo, encouraging others to be brave and follow their dreams.
